Build:
  python3 -I analysis/winmode_extract.py vm/traces/xfi_20261115_214519.log analysis/ent51/winmode_full.txt --full --end 89.8988
  # drop the 115 DSP-idle waits of the 5.1 switch: on Linux the idle word stays busy there (0x8/0x270), every one timed
  # out (20 ms, 2.3 s per load, over the driver's limit of 100) and the load works without them
  awk '$1 ~ /^#/ || !($4=="WAIT" && $1>77.4 && $1<81.1)' analysis/ent51/winmode_full.txt > x && mv x analysis/ent51/winmode_full.txt
  python3 -I src/fw_seq.py make analysis/ent51/winmode_full.txt analysis/ent51/winmode_seq.txt dist/xfi-dsp-linux/creative/{ha20x2k,CTEXFIFX}.sys
  python3 -I analysis/ent51_mode.py
  python3 -I src/fw_blob.py analysis/ent51/winmode_seq.txt analysis/ent51/mode.json dist/xfi-dsp-linux/creative analysis/ent51/xfi20k1-dsp.bin
